CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES
  FEBRUARY  24, 2026

1.  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Sternquist called  the
  City Council Special Meeting  to order at 6:
  16 p.
  m.in the Woman'
  s  Club
  Hall located  at 9704  Woodruff Avenue, Temple City.

2.  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Councilmember—
  Chavez,Chen, Yu, Man, Sternquist

  ABSENT:  Councilmember —  None

  ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Cook, City Attorney Murphy, Administrative Services Director Kung,
  Community Development Director Reimers, Parks and Recreation  Director
  Matsumoto, and Community Services and Public Safety Supervisor Amaya.

3.  PUBLIC  COMMENT -  None.

Mayor Sternquist changed  the order of the agenda and moved the Presentation  before the Reception.

5. PRESENTATION

  A. MAYOR'
  S STATE  OF THE CITY

  Mayor Sternquist  delivered  the State of the City Address.

4.  RECESS TO RECEPTION

  City Council Meeting  recessed to the reception at 7:
  20 p.
  m.

6. ADJOURNMENT

  The City Council  Special Meeting was adjourned  at 8:
  30 p.
  m.
